verdict.rationale: Supabase supports natural-language operation in two ways. Its Dashboard AI Assistant turns plain-language specs into SQL, debugs errors, and can generate and deploy Edge Functions. Its official MCP server, plugin and skills let AI agents such as Claude Code and Cursor query data, apply migrations, deploy functions and manage projects on the user's behalf. Probes confirm a live, OAuth-gated MCP endpoint and a local MCP server shipped with the CLI. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of an end-to-end natural-language session actually executing operations (probes only reached the auth gate), and the remote MCP server is still labeled Beta, with branching tools experimental.
